title: Seven bridges founded graph theory by being impossible
body: Königsberg's citizens wondered if one walk could cross each of its seven bridges exactly once. Euler modelled land as points and bridges as lines, then showed such a route needs at most two landmasses with an odd number of bridges; Königsberg had four. Answer: impossible, and a new field began with a 'no'.
source_hint: Euler, 'Solutio problematis ad geometriam situs pertinentis', 1736
